messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — automated page fired for service=/generate region=eu-west. PagerDuty: INC12345. Reason: p99 latency breach (4.7s) vs SLO 2.0s; SLO burn ~32% over 5m. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood.example/INC12345
sre-alex: acked. I'm investigating hotpath and node events. :eyes:
ops-jamal: looking at GKE events — 3 preemptions on gpu-pool-1 around 1685004200. Evictions and pod restarts coincident with latency spikes.
eng-runtime-maya: any recent runtime or tokenizer deploys to eu-west? need to rule out regressions.
sre-alex: no deploys in last 30m. KV cache hit rate dropped ~55% in same window — suggests cold-cache tail amplification.
eng-platform-lee: routing shows increased queue depth on edge-proxy replicas. Autoscaler didn't react due to pod disruption budget.
sre-alex: mitigation attempt: reduce max batch_size on ingress for /generate to 1 to avoid long queue head-of-line. Applying patch now.
sre-alex: patch applied — ingress batching=1. Observing p99 down to 3.1s after ~90s.
ops-jamal: spinning up 2 extra gpu nodes in eu-west as a precaution (scale up request submitted). ETA ~3m.
support-rina: CS: customers with strict 3s timeouts seeing degraded UX. Flagged top 5 affected accounts to account teams; sent initial heads-up.
manager-sam: good call. If traffic doesn't stabilize after scale, we should failover non-critical traffic to eu-fallback region.
eng-runtime-maya: can we evict large KV entries for low-priority models to warm cache? I'll run evict script targeting stale prefixes.
eng-platform-lee: evict job launched. KV hit rate recovering slowly.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: incident escalated to manager-sam due to >15m SLO burn.
sre-alex: p99 now ~2.5s, SLO burn down to ~6% in 5m window. Continuing to monitor 15m trend.
support-rina: Customer impact notes updated in INC12345 — will share postmortem draft if we confirm root cause.
manager-sam: plan: keep ingress batching disabled for 30m, complete node scale-up, capture traces, and schedule follow-up runbook update. Handoff to night oncall at 1685005000. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 - status: mitigating. Next update 1685005000.
